title: Images that are sometimes sources create two ways

sections.name: words
sections.label: Owner, 2026-11-24
sections.content:
my feeling is that this creates two ways. 
Can a user differentiate? Can I specify that this image is a source? 
This may add unnecessary complexity

sections.name: context
sections.content: Response to the agent's reading of vignette 7933630c (allowed, not automatic), under which an upload in an image paragraph would not create a source.
